captions.message:
You have successfully passed the simulation.
The test at Sector C is proceeding as planned.

As instructed,
you return to your workspace, believing the training exercise to be over.
But then, without warning, the unthinkable happens.
The training scenario becomes reality.

The true scale of the Resonance Cascade is only now beginning to reveal itself.
The entire planet is plunged into a desperate war against an invasion of alien fauna,
as reality itself begins to fracture.
Portal Storms engulf the world, tearing open gateways to unknown dimensions.
But the Xen invasion is only the beginning.

Something far more dangerous is coming.

I would like to personally thank everybody
who took part in testing and providing feedback
this has easily been the most stressful project
I have ever worked on.

This Project was started due to horrible circumstances
My Wife had a benign tumour called a Colloid Cyst. 
which resulted in a near fatal Acute hydrocephalus experience 
the tumour almost killed her, and she still remains in hospital 

it has been beyond 2 years. 
Her Husband, Her Children, Her Family
Will fight until she is home again
We love you, will every fibre.

Thank you
